- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/agent-host
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/agent-host/channels and adapters: feishu, telegram, weixin
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/agent-host/managed-process

Report on:
1. How the Agent Host runs Pi Coding Agent (utilityProcess), sessions, file config
2. Data/config persisted under ~/.pi/agent/
3. Channel architecture: how WeChat, Telegram, Feishu/Lark adapters work (long polling, WebSocket, SDK), inbound/outbound message flow, permissions, session binding
4. Managed process system (POSIX worker for macOS/Linux, Windows Job helper) for running dev servers/watchers/mock APIs
5. Any ownership boundaries between agent-host and main

List concrete file paths and important symbols with bounded evidence spans. Report concisely but comprehensively. Do NOT write any files.
I'll explore the Electron desktop app's agent-host layer thoroughly. Let me start by getting an overview of the directory structure.

507:     if (!filePath) return false;
508:     const storedName = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined).getSessionName();

515: function applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId: string, name: string): boolean | null {
516:   const existing = getRpcSession(sessionId);
517:   if (!existing?.isAlive()) return null;
518:   const currentName = existing.inner.sessionName;
519:   if (typeof currentName === "string" && currentName.trim().length > 0) return false;
520: 
521:   // Keep the check and write in the same synchronous turn. A manual rename
522:   // that ran first is observed above; one that runs later overwrites this
523:   // automatic value, so the manual choice always wins.
524:   existing.inner.setSessionName(name);
525:   return true;
526: }

528: export async function applySessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId: string, name: string): Promise<boolean> {
529:   const normalized = name.trim();
530:   if (!normalized) return false;
531: 
532:   const liveResult = applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId, normalized);
533:   if (liveResult !== null) return liveResult;
534: 
535:   const filePath = await resolveSessionPath(sessionId);
536:   if (!filePath) return false;
537: 
538:   // The session may have become live while its path was resolving.
539:   const liveResultAfterLookup = applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId, normalized);
540:   if (liveResultAfterLookup !== null) return liveResultAfterLookup;
541: 
542:   const manager = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined);
543:   const storedName = manager.getSessionName();
544:   if (typeof storedName === "string" && storedName.trim().length > 0) return false;
545: 
546:   // SessionManager's read and append are synchronous, so another Renderer RPC
547:   // cannot interleave a manual rename between this final check and the write.
548:   manager.appendSessionInfo(normalized);
549:   invalidateSessionContent(filePath);
550:   return true;
551: }

553: async function resolveTitleSessionTarget(
554:   sessionId: string,
555: ): Promise<{ cwd: string; services?: TitleModelServices } | null> {
556:   const existing = getRpcSession(sessionId);
557:   if (existing?.isAlive()) {
558:     const dir = validateExistingDirectory(existing.cwd);
559:     if (!dir.ok) return null;
560:     return {
561:       cwd: dir.path,
562:       services: {
563:         modelRuntime: existing.inner.modelRuntime as unknown as TitleSessionServices["modelRuntime"],
564:         settingsManager: existing.inner.settingsManager,
565:       },
566:     };
567:   }
568: 
569:   const filePath = await resolveSessionPath(sessionId);
570:   if (!filePath) return null;
571:   const cwd = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined).getHeader()?.cwd;
572:   const dir = validateExistingDirectory(cwd);
573:   return dir.ok ? { cwd: dir.path } : null;
574: }

576: type DirectoryValidation = { ok: true; path: string; canonicalPath: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
577: 
578: function validateExistingDirectory(candidate: unknown): DirectoryValidation {
579:   if (typeof candidate !== "string" || !candidate) return { ok: false, error: "Directory does not exist" };
580:   try {
581:     const realpath = realpathSync.native ?? realpathSync;
582:     const canonicalPath = realpath(candidate);
583:     if (!statSync(canonicalPath).isDirectory()) return { ok: false, error: "Not a directory" };
584:     return { ok: true, path: candidate, canonicalPath };
585:   } catch {
586:     return { ok: false, error: "Directory does not exist" };
587:   }
588: }
589: 
590: function canonicalPathForComparison(candidate: string): string {
591:   const resolved = path.resolve(candidate);
592:   let canonical = resolved;
593:   try {
594:     const realpath = realpathSync.native ?? realpathSync;
595:     canonical = realpath(resolved);
596:   } catch {
597:     // Historical session cwd values can refer to directories that no longer exist.
598:   }
599:   return process.platform === "win32" ? canonical.toLowerCase() : canonical;
600: }

604: async function resolveAvailableModels(
605:   modelRuntime: ModelRuntime,
606:   signal?: AbortSignal,
607: ): Promise<{ models: AvailableModel[]; warnings: ModelCatalogWarning[] }> {
608:   const snapshot = [...modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot()];
609:   const snapshotByProvider = new Map<string, AvailableModel[]>();
610:   for (const model of snapshot) {
611:     const models = snapshotByProvider.get(model.provider) ?? [];
612:     models.push(model);
613:     snapshotByProvider.set(model.provider, models);
614:   }
615: 
616:   const results = await Promise.all(
617:     [...modelRuntime.getProviders()]
618:       .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
619:       .map(async (provider) => {
620:         try {
621:           const models = [...(await modelRuntime.getAvailable(provider.id, { signal }))];
622:           return { models, warning: undefined };
623:         } catch (error) {
624:           if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? error;
625:           return {
626:             models: snapshotByProvider.get(provider.id) ?? [],
627:             warning: {
628:               provider: provider.id,
629:               code: "PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_FAILED" as const,
630:               message: `Unable to check ${provider.id} model availability; the last known state remains available.`,
631:             },
632:           };
633:         }
634:       }),
635:   );
636:   signal?.throwIfAborted();
637:   return {
638:     models: results.flatMap((result) => result.models),
639:     warnings: results.flatMap((result) => (result.warning ? [result.warning] : [])),
640:   };
641: }

643: export async function projectModelsList(
644:   modelRuntime: ModelRuntime,
645:   settings: SettingsManager,
646:   catalog: ModelCatalogStatus,
647:   options: { signal?: AbortSignal; cachedOnly?: boolean } = {},
648: ): Promise<ModelsListResult> {
649:   const availability = options.cachedOnly
650:     ? { models: [...modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot()], warnings: [] }
651:     : await resolveAvailableModels(modelRuntime, options.signal);
652:   const available = availability.models;
653:   const enabledModels = settings.getEnabledModels();
654:   const visible = filterByExactEnabledModels(available, enabledModels);
655:   const models = visible
656:     .map((model) => ({ id: model.id, name: model.name, provider: model.provider }))
657:     .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) || a.provider.localeCompare(b.provider));
658: 
659:   const nameMap: Record<string, string> = {};
660:   const thinkingLevels: Record<string, string[]> = {};
661:   const thinkingLevelMaps: Record<string, Record<string, string | null>> = {};
662:   for (const model of visible) {
663:     const key = `${model.provider}:${model.id}`;
664:     nameMap[key] = model.name;
665:     thinkingLevels[key] = getSupportedThinkingLevels(model);
666:     if (model.thinkingLevelMap) thinkingLevelMaps[key] = model.thinkingLevelMap;
667:   }
668: 
669:   let defaultModel: { provider: string; modelId: string } | null = null;
670:   const provider = settings.getDefaultProvider();
671:   const modelId = settings.getDefaultModel();
672:   if (provider && modelId && visible.some((model) => model.provider === provider && model.id === modelId)) {
673:     defaultModel = { provider, modelId };
674:   }

676:   return {
677:     models,
678:     defaultModel,
679:     thinkingLevels,
680:     thinkingLevelMaps,
681:     nameMap,
682:     catalog: availability.warnings.length
683:       ? { ...catalog, warnings: [...catalog.warnings, ...availability.warnings] }
684:       : catalog,

142:       const text = (block as { text?: unknown }).text;
143:       if (typeof text !== "string") return block;
144:       const stripped = stripLegacyChannelPromptText(text);
145:       if (stripped === text) return block;
146:       changed = true;
147:       return { ...block, text: stripped };
148:     });
149:     return changed ? { ...message, content } : message;
150:   });
151: }

153: export function withExtensionTools(session: AgentSessionLike, toolNames: string[]): string[] {
154:   if (toolNames.length === 0) return [];

156:   const codingToolNames = new Set(CODING_TOOL_NAMES);
157:   const extensionToolNames = session
158:     .getAllTools()
159:     .map((t) => t.name)
160:     .filter((name) => !codingToolNames.has(name) && !isBrowserToolName(name));
161: 
162:   return [...new Set([...toolNames, ...extensionToolNames])];

309:   private ensureExtensionsBound(options: ExtensionBindingOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
310:     if (options.forceEmptySystemPrompt) this.forceEmptySystemPrompt = true;
311:     if (this.extensionsBound) {
312:       this.applyForcedEmptySystemPrompt();
313:       return Promise.resolve();
314:     }
315:     if (this.extensionBindingPromise) return this.extensionBindingPromise;
316: 
317:     this.extensionBindingError = null;
318:     const attempt = ++this.extensionBindingAttempt;
319:     const startedAt = Date.now();
320:     const bindingPromise: Promise<void> = (async () => {
321:       if (!this._alive) return;
322:       const uiContext = this.createExtensionUiContext();
323:       if (typeof this.inner.bindExtensions === "function") {
324:         const bindExtensions = this.inner.bindExtensions as (bindings: {
325:           uiContext?: ExtensionUiContextLike;
326:           mode?: "rpc";
327:           commandContextActions?: ExtensionCommandContextActionsLike;
328:           shutdownHandler?: () => void;
329:           onError?: (error: { extensionPath: string; event: string; error: string }) => void;
330:         }) => Promise<void>;
331:         await bindExtensions.call(this.inner, {
332:           uiContext,
333:           mode: "rpc",
334:           commandContextActions: this.createExtensionCommandContextActions(),
335:           shutdownHandler: () =>
336:             this.emit({
337:               type: "extension_ui_request",
338:               id: randomUUID(),
339:               method: "notify",
340:               notifyType: "warning",
341:               message: "Extension requested shutdown, but shutdown is not supported in Pi Desktop.",
342:             } as ExtensionUiRequest as AgentEvent),
343:           onError: (error) =>
344:             this.emit({
345:               type: "extension_error",
346:               extensionPath: error.extensionPath,
347:               event: error.event,
348:               error: error.error,
349:             }),
350:         });
351:       } else {
352:         this.inner.extensionRunner.setUIContext?.(uiContext, "rpc");
353:       }
354:       this.extensionsBound = true;
355:       this.applyForcedEmptySystemPrompt();
356:       console.log(`[pi-desktop] session_start dispatched to extensions for session ${this.inner.sessionId}`);
357:     })()
358:       .catch((err) => {
359:         this.extensionBindingError = err;
360:         console.warn(
361:           `[pi-desktop] extension binding attempt ${attempt} failed after ${Date.now() - startedAt}ms for session ${this.inner.sessionId}`,
362:         );
363:         throw err;
364:       })
365:       .finally(() => {
366:         if (this.extensionBindingPromise === bindingPromise) this.extensionBindingPromise = null;
367:       });
368:     this.extensionBindingPromise = bindingPromise;
369: 
370:     return bindingPromise;
371:   }

373:   private async waitForExtensionsBound(): Promise<void> {
374:     try {
375:       if (!this.extensionsBound) await this.ensureExtensionsBound();
376:     } catch (err) {
377:       throw err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
378:     }
379:     if (this.extensionBindingError) {
380:       throw this.extensionBindingError instanceof Error
381:         ? this.extensionBindingError
382:         : new Error(String(this.extensionBindingError));
383:     }
384:   }

415:     const base = String(this.inner.agent.state.systemPrompt ?? "")

425:   private enqueueTurn<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
426:     this.queuedTurnCount += 1;
427:     notifyRunningChange();
428:     const run = this.turnTail
429:       .catch(() => undefined)
430:       .then(async () => {
431:         if (!this._alive) throw new Error("Agent session is no longer available");
432:         this.promptRunning = true;
433:         notifyRunningChange();
434:         try {
435:           return await task();
436:         } finally {
437:           this.promptRunning = false;
438:           this.queuedTurnCount = Math.max(0, this.queuedTurnCount - 1);
439:           notifyRunningChange();
440:         }
441:       });
442:     this.turnTail = run.then(
443:       () => undefined,
444:       () => undefined,
445:     );
446:     return run;
447:   }

449:   async runExternalTurn(params: {
450:     runId: string;
451:     message: string;
452:     channel: ChannelId;
453:     images?: Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }>;
454:     channelAttachments?: ChannelMessageAttachment[];
455:     attachmentContext?: string;
456:     onProgress?: (event: AgentEvent) => void;
457:   }): Promise<{ runId: string; finalText: string }> {
458:     return this.enqueueTurn(async () => {
459:       this.emit({ type: "channel_turn_start", runId: params.runId });
460:       this.externalTurnActive = true;
461:       this.externalTurnChannel = params.channel;
462:       this.externalTurnAttachments = params.channelAttachments ?? null;
463:       setBrowserSessionSource(this.inner.sessionManager, "channel");
464:       browserAgentRuntime.beginTurn(this.sessionId, "channel");
465:       this.externalTurnProgress = params.onProgress ?? null;
466:       try {
467:         this.inner.sessionManager.appendCustomEntry("pi-desktop-channel-source", {
468:           runId: params.runId,
469:           channel: params.channel,
470:           ...(params.channelAttachments?.length ? { attachments: params.channelAttachments } : {}),
471:         });
472:         if (params.attachmentContext) {
473:           await this.inner.sendCustomMessage(
474:             {
475:               customType: "pi-desktop-channel-attachment-context",
476:               content: params.attachmentContext,
477:               display: false,
478:             },
479:             { deliverAs: "nextTurn" },
480:           );
481:         }
482:         await this.inner.prompt(params.message, {
483:           ...(params.images?.length ? { images: params.images } : {}),
484:           expandPromptTemplates: false,
485:           source: "rpc",
486:         });
487:         const finalText = this.inner.getLastAssistantText()?.trim() ?? "";
488:         this.emit({ type: "channel_turn_end", runId: params.runId, finalText });
489:         return { runId: params.runId, finalText };
490:       } catch (error) {
491:         try {
492:           this.inner.sessionManager.appendCustomEntry("pi-desktop-channel-source-cancelled", { runId: params.runId });
493:         } catch {
494:           // A best-effort UI marker must never hide the original turn failure.
495:         }
496:         this.emit({
497:           type: "channel_turn_error",
498:           runId: params.runId,
499:           errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
500:         });
501:         throw error;
502:       } finally {
503:         this.externalTurnProgress = null;
504:         this.externalTurnActive = false;
505:         this.externalTurnChannel = null;
506:         this.externalTurnAttachments = null;
507:         setBrowserSessionSource(this.inner.sessionManager, "local");
508:       }
509:     });
510:   }

512:   private async reloadSessionResources(): Promise<void> {

514:       try {

518:       }
519:     }
520:     this.extensionsBound = false;
521:     this.extensionBindingPromise = null;
522:     this.extensionBindingError = null;
523:     this.extensionStatuses.clear();
524:     this.extensionWidgets.clear();
525:     await this.inner.reload();
526:     await this.ensureExtensionsBound();
527:     if (this.requestedToolNames !== undefined) this.applyRequestedTools(this.requestedToolNames);
528:     this.applyForcedEmptySystemPrompt();
529:     this.applyToolchainSummary();
530:   }

542:   private resetIdleTimer(): void {
543:     if (this.idleTimer) clearTimeout(this.idleTimer);
544:     this.idleTimer = setTimeout(
545:       () => {
546:         // Never idle-evict a still-running agent (ISSUE-003)
547:         if (this.isRunning()) {
548:           this.resetIdleTimer();
549:           return;
550:         }
551:         void this.dispose({ abort: true, reason: "idle-eviction" });
552:       },
553:       10 * 60 * 1000,
554:     );
555:   }

557:   onEvent(listener: EventListener): () => void {
558:     this.listeners.push(listener);
559:     for (const event of this.pendingUiRequests.values()) listener(event);
560:     return () => {
561:       const i = this.listeners.indexOf(listener);
562:       if (i !== -1) this.listeners.splice(i, 1);
563:     };
564:   }

566:   onDestroy(cb: () => void): () => void {
567:     if (!this._alive) {
568:       cb();
569:       return () => undefined;
570:     }
571:     this.destroyCallbacks.add(cb);
572:     return () => this.destroyCallbacks.delete(cb);
573:   }

575:   async send(command: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
576:     this.resetIdleTimer();
577:     const type = command.type as string;
578:     if (this.shouldWaitForExtensions(type)) await this.waitForExtensionsBound();
579: 
580:     switch (type) {
581:       case "prompt": {
582:         // Fire and forget — events come via subscribe
583:         const promptImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
584:         const streamingBehavior = command.streamingBehavior as "steer" | "followUp" | undefined;
585:         if (!streamingBehavior) browserAgentRuntime.beginTurn(this.sessionId, "local");
586:         const invokePrompt = () =>
587:           this.inner.prompt(command.message as string, {
588:             ...(promptImages?.length ? { images: promptImages } : {}),
589:             ...(streamingBehavior ? { streamingBehavior } : {}),
590:             source: "rpc",
591:           });
592:         const operation = streamingBehavior ? invokePrompt() : this.enqueueTurn(invokePrompt);
593:         operation
594:           .then(() => {
595:             if (!streamingBehavior) this.emit({ type: "prompt_done" });
596:           })
597:           .catch((error) => {
598:             this.emit({
599:               type: "prompt_error",
600:               errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
601:             });
602:             if (!streamingBehavior) this.emit({ type: "prompt_done" });
603:           });
604:         return null;
605:       }
606: 
607:       case "abort":
608:         await this.withFinalRunningNotification(() => this.inner.abort());
609:         return null;
610: 
611:       case "get_state": {
612:         const model = this.inner.model;
613:         const contextUsage = this.inner.getContextUsage();
614:         return {
615:           sessionId: this.inner.sessionId,
616:           sessionFile: this.inner.sessionFile ?? "",
617:           isStreaming: this.inner.isStreaming,
618:           isPromptRunning: this.promptRunning,
619:           isCompacting: this.inner.isCompacting,
620:           autoCompactionEnabled: this.inner.autoCompactionEnabled,
621:           autoRetryEnabled: this.inner.autoRetryEnabled,
622:           model: model ? { id: model.id, provider: model.provider } : undefined,
623:           messageCount: 0,
624:           pendingMessageCount: this.inner.pendingMessageCount,
625:           queuedMessages: {
626:             steering: [...this.inner.getSteeringMessages()],
627:             followUp: [...this.inner.getFollowUpMessages()],
628:           },
629:           contextUsage: contextUsage
630:             ? { percent: contextUsage.percent, contextWindow: contextUsage.contextWindow, tokens: contextUsage.tokens }
631:             : null,
632:           systemPrompt: this.inner.agent.state?.systemPrompt ?? "",
633:           thinkingLevel: this.inner.agent.state?.thinkingLevel ?? "off",
634:           extensionStatuses: this.getExtensionStatuses(),
635:           extensionWidgets: this.getExtensionWidgets(),
636:         };
637:       }
638: 
639:       case "set_model": {
640:         const { provider, modelId } = command as { provider: string; modelId: string };
641:         const model = this.inner.modelRuntime.getModel(provider, modelId);
642:         if (!model) throw new Error(`Model not found: ${provider}/${modelId}`);
643:         await this.inner.setModel(model);
644:         return { id: model.id, provider: model.provider };
645:       }
646: 
647:       case "fork": {
648:         const entryId = command.entryId as string;
649:         const sessionManager = this.inner.sessionManager;
650:         const currentSessionFile = this.inner.sessionFile;
651: 
652:         if (!sessionManager.isPersisted()) return { cancelled: true };
653:         if (!currentSessionFile) throw new Error("Persisted session is missing a session file");
654: 
655:         const entry = sessionManager.getEntry(entryId);
656:         if (!entry) throw new Error("Invalid entry ID for forking");
657: 
658:         const sessionDir = sessionManager.getSessionDir();
659:         let newSessionFile: string;
660: 
661:         if (!entry.parentId) {
662:           // Fork before the first message: create an empty session linked to this one
663:           const newManager = SessionManager.create(sessionManager.getCwd(), sessionDir);
664:           newManager.newSession({ parentSession: currentSessionFile });
665:           newSessionFile = newManager.getSessionFile() as string;
666:         } else {
667:           // Fork after some history: copy path up to (but not including) the fork point
668:           const sourceManager = SessionManager.open(currentSessionFile, sessionDir);
669:           const forkedPath = sourceManager.createBranchedSession(entry.parentId);
670:           if (!forkedPath) throw new Error("Failed to create forked session");
671:           newSessionFile = forkedPath;
672:         }
673: 
674:         const newSessionId = SessionManager.open(newSessionFile, sessionDir).getSessionId();
675:         cacheSessionPath(newSessionId, newSessionFile);
676:         await this.dispose({ abort: true, reason: "fork" });
677:         return { cancelled: false, newSessionId };
678:       }
679: 
680:       case "navigate_tree": {
681:         const result = await this.inner.navigateTree(command.targetId as string, {});
682:         return { cancelled: result.cancelled };
683:       }
684: 
685:       case "set_thinking_level": {
686:         const level = command.level as string;
687:         this.inner.setThinkingLevel(level);
688:         // setThinkingLevel clamps xhigh→high for models where supportsXhigh()===false.
689:         // If the model has DeepSeek thinking compat (reasoningEffortMap maps xhigh→max),
690:         // force the state back so the compat layer can use it correctly.
691:         if (
692:           level === "xhigh" &&
693:           (this.inner.model as { compat?: { thinkingFormat?: string } } | null)?.compat?.thinkingFormat ===
694:             "deepseek" &&
695:           this.inner.agent?.state
696:         ) {
697:           this.inner.agent.state.thinkingLevel = "xhigh";
698:         }
699:         return null;
700:       }
701: 
702:       case "compact": {
703:         const result = await this.withFinalRunningNotification(() =>
704:           this.enqueueTurn(() => this.inner.compact(command.customInstructions as string | undefined)),
705:         );
706:         return result;
707:       }
708: 
709:       case "set_session_name": {
710:         const name = (command.name as string | undefined)?.trim();
711:         if (!name) throw new Error("Session name cannot be empty");
712:         this.inner.setSessionName(name);
713:         return null;
714:       }
715: 
716:       case "get_session_stats": {
717:         return {
718:           ...this.inner.getSessionStats(),
719:           sessionName: this.inner.sessionManager.getSessionName(),
720:         };
721:       }
722: 
723:       case "get_last_assistant_text": {
724:         return { text: this.inner.getLastAssistantText() ?? "" };
725:       }
726: 
727:       case "set_auto_compaction": {
728:         this.inner.setAutoCompactionEnabled(command.enabled as boolean);
729:         return null;
730:       }
731: 
732:       case "clear_queue": {
733:         // Full clear only: pi has no single-item dequeue, and clear+requeue
734:         // races against the agent loop pulling messages mid-flight.
735:         return this.inner.clearQueue();
736:       }
737: 
738:       case "steer": {
739:         const steerImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
740:         await this.inner.steer(command.message as string, steerImages?.length ? steerImages : undefined);
741:         return null;
742:       }
743: 
744:       case "follow_up": {
745:         const followImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
746:         await this.inner.followUp(command.message as string, followImages?.length ? followImages : undefined);

750:       case "get_tools": {

760:       case "get_commands": {

762:         for (const registered of this.inner.extensionRunner.getRegisteredCommands()) {

765:             description: registered.description,
766:             source: "extension",

770:         for (const template of this.inner.promptTemplates) {

789:       case "set_tools": {

827:   /**
828:    * Stop the underlying agent and release resources. Calls are idempotent and
829:    * concurrent owners share one teardown attempt.
830:    */
831:   dispose(options: { abort?: boolean; reason?: string; timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<void> {
832:     if (this.disposePromise) return this.disposePromise;
833:     const abort = options.abort !== false;
834:     const reason = options.reason ?? "explicit";
835:     const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 5_000;
836:     this.destroy();
837: 
838:     this.disposePromise = (async () => {
839:       const teardown = async () => {
840:         if (abort) {
841:           try {
842:             await this.inner.abort();
843:           } catch (error) {
844:             console.warn(
845:               `[pi-desktop] session abort failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
846:             );
847:           }
848:         }
849:         const agent = this.inner.agent as { waitForIdle?: () => Promise<void>; dispose?: () => void | Promise<void> };
850:         try {
851:           await agent.waitForIdle?.();
852:         } catch (error) {
853:           console.warn(
854:             `[pi-desktop] session waitForIdle failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
855:           );
856:         }
857:         try {
858:           await agent.dispose?.();
859:         } catch (error) {
860:           console.warn(
861:             `[pi-desktop] session dispose failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
862:           );
863:         }
864:       };
865: 
866:       let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
867:       try {
868:         await Promise.race([
869:           teardown(),
870:           new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
871:             timeout = setTimeout(() => {
872:               console.warn(`[pi-desktop] session teardown timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms during ${reason}`);
873:               resolve();
874:             }, timeoutMs);
875:           }),
876:         ]);
877:       } finally {
878:         if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
879:       }
880:     })();
881:     return this.disposePromise;
882:   }
883: 
884:   async abortAndDispose(): Promise<void> {
885:     await this.dispose({ abort: true, reason: "explicit" });
886:   }

888:   destroy(): void {
889:     if (!this._alive) return;
890:     this._alive = false;
891:     browserAgentRuntime.clearSession(this.sessionId);
892:     if (this.idleTimer) clearTimeout(this.idleTimer);
893:     this.unsubscribe?.();
894:     this.unsubscribe = null;
895:     for (const pending of this.pendingUiResponses.values()) pending.cancel();
896:     for (const id of Array.from(this.activeCustomUis.keys())) this.closeCustomUi(id, undefined);
897:     this.pendingUiResponses.clear();
898:     this.pendingUiRequests.clear();
899:     this.listeners = [];
900:     const destroyCallbacks = [...this.destroyCallbacks];
901:     this.destroyCallbacks.clear();
902:     for (const callback of destroyCallbacks) {
903:       try {
904:         callback();
905:       } catch {
906:         /* isolate teardown owners */
907:       }
908:     }
909:     notifyRunningChange();
910:   }

1026:   private requestExtensionCustomUi<T>(factory: unknown, options?: unknown): Promise<T> {
1027:     if (this.externalTurnActive) {
1028:       this.emit({
1029:         type: "channel_headless_ui_blocked",
1030:         feature: "custom",
1031:         errorMessage: "Interactive extension UI is unavailable for messaging-channel turns.",
1032:       });
1033:       return Promise.resolve(undefined as T);
1034:     }
1035:     if (typeof factory !== "function") return Promise.resolve(undefined as T);
1036: 
1037:     const id = randomUUID();
1038:     const width = this.getCustomUiWidth(options);
1039: 
1040:     return new Promise<T>((resolve) => {
1041:       const tui = {
1042:         requestRender: () => {
1043:           const custom = this.activeCustomUis.get(id);
1044:           if (custom) this.emitCustomUiRender(id, custom);
1045:         },
1046:       };
1047:       const done = (value: T) => this.closeCustomUi(id, value);
1048: 
1049:       Promise.resolve()
1050:         .then(() => factory(tui, undefined, undefined, done))
1051:         .then((component) => {
1052:           if (
1053:             !component ||
1054:             typeof component !== "object" ||
1055:             typeof (component as CustomUiComponent).render !== "function"
1056:           ) {
1057:             resolve(undefined as T);
1058:             return;
1059:           }
1060:           const custom: ActiveCustomUi = {
1061:             component: component as CustomUiComponent,
1062:             width,
1063:             resolve: (value) => resolve(value as T),
1064:             settled: false,
1065:           };
1066:           this.activeCustomUis.set(id, custom);
1067:           this.emitCustomUiRender(id, custom);
1068:         })
1069:         .catch((error) => {
1070:           this.emit({
1071:             type: "extension_error",
1072:             extensionPath: `custom-ui:${id}`,
1073:             event: "custom_ui",
1074:             error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
1075:           });
1076:           resolve(undefined as T);
1077:         });
1078:     });
1079:   }

1081:   private requestExtensionUi<T>(
1082:     request: ExtensionUiRequestBody,
1083:     defaultValue: T,
1084:     parseResponse: (response: ExtensionUiResponse) => T,
1085:     timeout?: number,
1086:     signal?: AbortSignal,
1087:   ): Promise<T> {
1088:     if (this.externalTurnActive) {
1089:       this.emit({
1090:         type: "channel_headless_ui_blocked",
1091:         feature: request.method,
1092:         errorMessage: "Interactive extension UI is unavailable for messaging-channel turns.",
1093:       });
1094:       return Promise.resolve(defaultValue);
1095:     }
1096:     if (signal?.aborted) return Promise.resolve(defaultValue);
1097: 
1098:     const id = randomUUID();
1099:     const fullRequest = {
1100:       type: "extension_ui_request",
1101:       id,
1102:       ...request,
1103:       ...(timeout ? { timeout, expiresAt: Date.now() + timeout } : {}),
1104:     };
1105: 
1106:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
1107:       let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
1108:       const cleanup = () => {
1109:         if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
1110:         signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
1111:         this.pendingUiRequests.delete(id);
1112:         this.pendingUiResponses.delete(id);
1113:       };
1114:       const settle = (value: T) => {
1115:         cleanup();
1116:         resolve(value);
1117:       };
1118:       const onAbort = () => settle(defaultValue);
1119: 
1120:       if (timeout) timeoutId = setTimeout(() => settle(defaultValue), timeout);
1121:       signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
1122: 
1123:       this.pendingUiRequests.set(id, fullRequest as AgentEvent);
1124:       this.pendingUiResponses.set(id, {
1125:         resolve: (response) => settle(parseResponse(response)),
1126:         cancel: () => settle(defaultValue),
1127:       });
1128:       this.emit(fullRequest as AgentEvent);
1129:     });
1130:   }

1315: // ============================================================================
1316: // Session registry
1317: // ============================================================================
1318: 
1319: const sessionRegistry = new Map<string, AgentSessionWrapper>();
1320: const startLocks = new Map<string, Promise<{ session: AgentSessionWrapper; realSessionId: string }>>();
1321: const runningListeners = new Set<(ids: string[]) => void>();
1322: let registryCleanupInstalled = false;
1323: 
1324: function getRegistry(): Map<string, AgentSessionWrapper> {
1325:   if (!registryCleanupInstalled) {
1326:     registryCleanupInstalled = true;
1327:     const cleanup = () => sessionRegistry.forEach((session) => session.destroy());
1328:     process.once("exit", cleanup);
1329:     process.once("SIGINT", cleanup);
1330:     process.once("SIGTERM", cleanup);
1331:   }
1332:   return sessionRegistry;
1333: }
1334: 
1335: function getLocks(): Map<string, Promise<{ session: AgentSessionWrapper; realSessionId: string }>> {
1336:   return startLocks;
1337: }

1339: export function getRpcSession(sessionId: string): AgentSessionWrapper | undefined {
1340:   return getRegistry().get(sessionId);
1341: }

1343: export async function disposeAllRpcSessions(reason = "host-shutdown"): Promise<void> {
1344:   await Promise.all([...getRegistry().values()].map((session) => session.dispose({ abort: true, reason })));
1345: }

1347: export function syncBrowserToolsForAllSessions(): void {
1348:   for (const session of getRegistry().values()) session.syncBrowserToolActivation();
1349: }

1351: export function getRunningRpcSessionIds(): string[] {
1352:   const ids = new Set<string>();
1353:   for (const [sessionId, session] of getRegistry()) {
1354:     if (session.isRunning()) ids.add(session.sessionId || sessionId);
1355:   }
1356:   return [...ids];
1357: }

1359: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
1360: // Running-status broadcaster
1361: //
1362: // Pushes the current set of running session ids to subscribers whenever any
1363: // session's running state may have changed. This lets the sidebar receive live
1364: // MessagePort updates instead of polling.
1365: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
1366: 
1367: function getRunningListeners(): Set<(ids: string[]) => void> {
1368:   return runningListeners;
1369: }
1370: 
1371: /** Subscribe to running-session-id changes. Returns an unsubscribe function. */
1372: export function subscribeRunningSessions(listener: (ids: string[]) => void): () => void {
1373:   const listeners = getRunningListeners();
1374:   listeners.add(listener);
1375:   return () => {
1376:     listeners.delete(listener);
1377:   };

446:       (event) => {
447:         if (this.loginWaits.get(key) !== pending) return;
448:         if (event.phase !== "confirmed") {
449:           this.loginWaits.delete(key);
450:           return;
451:         }
452:         const timer = setTimeout(() => {
453:           if (this.loginWaits.get(key) === pending) this.loginWaits.delete(key);
454:           this.loginWaitCleanupTimers.delete(key);
455:         }, LOGIN_SUCCESS_RETENTION_MS);
456:         timer.unref?.();
457:         this.loginWaitCleanupTimers.set(key, timer);
458:       },
459:       () => {
460:         if (this.loginWaits.get(key) === pending) this.loginWaits.delete(key);
461:       },
462:     );
463:     return pending;
464:   }

466:   private async waitLoginOnce(channel: ChannelId, sessionKey: string): Promise<ChannelLoginEvent> {
467:     const pollLogin = this.registry.get(channel).pollLogin;
468:     if (!pollLogin) throw new Error(`${channel} does not use interactive login`);
469:     const result = await pollLogin.call(this.registry.get(channel), sessionKey);
470:     if (result.credential && result.event.accountId) {
471:       try {
472:         const accountId = result.event.accountId;
473:         const now = new Date().toISOString();
474:         const existing = this.config.getAccount(accountId);
475:         const previousSecret = await this.getSecret({ channel, id: accountId }).catch(() => null);
476:         const ownerUserId = result.account?.ownerUserId?.trim();
477:         const appId = result.account?.appId?.trim();
478:         const domain = result.account?.domain;
479:         if (channel === "feishu") {
480:           const expectedAccountId =
481:             appId && domain
482:               ? `feishu-${createHash("sha256").update(`${domain}\0${appId}`).digest("hex").slice(0, 24)}`
483:               : "";
484:           if (!appId || !/^cli_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(appId) || !domain || expectedAccountId !== accountId) {
485:             const event: ChannelLoginEvent = {
486:               channel,
487:               sessionKey,
488:               phase: "error",
489:               message: "飞书/Lark 返回的应用信息无效，请重新扫码。",
490:             };
491:             this.server.emit("channels.login", sessionKey, event);
492:             return event;
493:           }
494:         }
495:         const allowFrom = new Set(existing?.allowFrom ?? []);
496:         if (ownerUserId) allowFrom.add(ownerUserId);
497:         const baseUrl =
498:           channel === "feishu"
499:             ? domain === "lark"
500:               ? "https://open.larksuite.com"
501:               : "https://open.feishu.cn"
502:             : result.credential.baseUrl;
503:         const credential: ChannelSecret = { ...result.credential, baseUrl };
504:         const provisional: ChannelAccountConfig = {
505:           id: accountId,
506:           channel,
507:           name:
508:             existing?.name || result.account?.displayName || `${channelDisplayName(channel)} ${accountId.slice(-6)}`,
509:           enabled: true,
510:           ...(channel !== "feishu" ? { providerAccountId: credential.providerAccountId } : {}),
511:           ...(credential.providerUsername ? { providerUsername: credential.providerUsername } : {}),
512:           ...(ownerUserId ? { userId: ownerUserId } : {}),
513:           baseUrl,
514:           ...(channel === "feishu" && appId ? { appId } : {}),
515:           ...(channel === "feishu" && domain ? { domain } : {}),
516:           dmPolicy: existing?.dmPolicy ?? (channel === "feishu" && ownerUserId ? "allowlist" : "pairing"),
517:           allowFrom: [...allowFrom],
518:           groupPolicy: existing?.groupPolicy ?? "disabled",
519:           groupIds: existing?.groupIds ?? [],
520:           groupAllowFrom: existing?.groupAllowFrom ?? [],
521:           requireMention: existing?.requireMention ?? true,
522:           commandsEnabled: existing?.commandsEnabled ?? false,
523:           ...(existing?.defaultCwd ? { defaultCwd: existing.defaultCwd } : {}),
524:           toolNames: existing?.toolNames ?? [],
525:           createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? now,
526:           updatedAt: now,
527:         };
528:         try {
529:           await this.setSecret(channel, accountId, credential);
530:           this.config.upsertAccount(provisional);
531:         } catch {
532:           if (previousSecret) await this.setSecret(channel, accountId, previousSecret).catch(() => undefined);
533:           else await this.secretAccess.delete(channel, accountId).catch(() => undefined);
534:           try {
535:             if (existing) this.config.upsertAccount(existing);
536:             else this.config.deleteAccount(accountId);
537:           } catch {
538:             /* The original persistence error remains authoritative. */
539:           }
540:           const event: ChannelLoginEvent = {
541:             channel,
542:             sessionKey,
543:             phase: "error",
544:             message: "应用已创建，但安全保存失败。请在飞书/Lark 后台删除该应用后重试。",
545:             accountId,
546:           };
547:           this.server.emit("channels.login", sessionKey, event);
548:           return event;
549:         }
550: 
551:         const probe = await this.registry
552:           .get(channel)
553:           .probe(provisional, credential)
554:           .catch(() => ({ ok: false as const, accountId, message: "无法验证机器人身份，请检查网络后重试。" }));
555:         if (!probe.ok) {
556:           const probeMessage = safeChannelError(probe.message).split(credential.token).join("[REDACTED]");
557:           const message = `应用已创建并安全保存，但连接检查失败：${probeMessage}`;
558:           this.emitStatus(provisional, { state: "error", connected: false, lastError: message });
559:           const event: ChannelLoginEvent = { channel, sessionKey, phase: "error", message, accountId };
560:           this.server.emit("channels.login", sessionKey, event);
561:           return event;
562:         }
563: 
564:         const providerAccountId = probe.providerAccountId ?? credential.providerAccountId;
565:         const providerUsername = probe.providerUsername ?? credential.providerUsername;
566:         const savedSecret: ChannelSecret = {
567:           ...credential,
568:           providerAccountId,
569:           ...(providerUsername ? { providerUsername } : {}),
570:         };
571:         try {
572:           await this.setSecret(channel, accountId, savedSecret);
573:           this.config.upsertAccount({
574:             ...provisional,
575:             name:
576:               existing?.name ||
577:               providerUsername ||
578:               probe.displayName ||
579:               result.account?.displayName ||
580:               provisional.name,
581:             providerAccountId,
582:             ...(providerUsername ? { providerUsername } : {}),
583:             updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
584:           });
585:           await this.restartAccount(accountId);
586:         } catch {
587:           const event: ChannelLoginEvent = {
588:             channel,
589:             sessionKey,
590:             phase: "error",
591:             message: "应用已创建并安全保存，但机器人启动失败。账号已保留，可稍后重试。",
592:             accountId,
593:           };
594:           this.server.emit("channels.login", sessionKey, event);
595:           return event;
596:         }
597:         result.event = {
598:           ...result.event,
599:           message: channel === "feishu" ? "飞书/Lark 机器人已创建并连接。" : result.event.message,
600:         };
601:       } finally {
602:         result.finalize?.();
603:       }
604:     }
605:     this.server.emit("channels.login", sessionKey, result.event);
606:     return result.event;
607:   }

687:   private resolveBinding(account: ChannelAccountConfig, envelope: InboundEnvelope): ChannelBinding {
688:     const bindings = this.config.listBindings();
689:     const exact = bindings.find(
690:       (binding) =>
691:         binding.channel === envelope.channel &&
692:         binding.accountId === envelope.accountId &&
693:         binding.peerKind === envelope.peer.kind &&
694:         binding.peerId === envelope.peer.id &&
695:         (binding.threadId ?? "") === (envelope.threadId ?? ""),
696:     );
697:     if (exact) return exact;
698:     const peerBinding = bindings.find(
699:       (binding) =>
700:         binding.channel === envelope.channel &&
701:         binding.accountId === envelope.accountId &&
702:         binding.peerKind === envelope.peer.kind &&
703:         binding.peerId === envelope.peer.id &&
704:         !binding.threadId,
705:     );
706:     if (peerBinding) return peerBinding;
707:     const now = new Date().toISOString();
708:     const cwd =
709:       account.defaultCwd ??
710:       path.join(
711:         userDataPath(),
712:         "channel-workspaces",
713:         envelope.channel,
714:         account.id,
715:         workspaceSegment(routeKey(envelope)),
716:       );
717:     const created = this.config.upsertBinding({
718:       id: bindingId(envelope),
719:       channel: envelope.channel,
720:       accountId: envelope.accountId,
721:       peerKind: envelope.peer.kind,
722:       peerId: envelope.peer.id,
723:       ...(envelope.threadId ? { threadId: envelope.threadId } : {}),
724:       cwd,
725:       toolNames: account.toolNames,
726:       createdAt: now,
727:       lastUsedAt: now,
728:     });
729:     this.server.emit("channels.binding", created.id, {
730:       action: "upsert",
731:       bindingId: created.id,
732:       binding: created,
733:     });
734:     return created;
735:   }

750:   private async handleCommand(
751:     account: ChannelAccountConfig,
752:     binding: ChannelBinding,
753:     command: ParsedChannelCommand,
754:   ): Promise<{ finalText: string; sessionId?: string; notifySession?: boolean }> {
755:     if (command.name !== "compact" && command.args) {
756:       return { finalText: `用法：/${command.name}` };
757:     }
758: 
759:     if (command.name === "help") return { finalText: channelCommandHelpText() };
760: 
761:     if (command.name === "status") {
762:       const runtime = this.statuses.get(account.id);
763:       const session = this.bridge.getSessionStatus(binding);
764:       const channelName = channelDisplayName(account.channel);
765:       return {
766:         finalText: [
767:           `渠道：${channelName} · ${runtime?.connected ? "已连接" : "未连接"}`,
768:           `会话：${session.hasSession ? "已绑定" : "尚未创建"}`,
769:           `Agent：${session.running ? "处理中" : "空闲"}`,
770:           "IM 命令：已启用",
771:         ].join("\n"),
772:       };
773:     }
774: 
775:     if (command.name === "new") {
776:       const created = await this.bridge.newSession(binding, account.toolNames);
777:       return {
778:         sessionId: created.sessionId,
779:         notifySession: true,
780:         finalText: "已开始新的独立会话，后续消息将使用新的上下文。",
781:       };
782:     }
783: 
784:     if (!binding.sessionId) {
785:       return {
786:         finalText: command.name === "compact" ? "当前还没有可压缩的会话。" : "当前还没有可重新加载的会话。",
787:       };
788:     }
789: 
790:     const result = await this.bridge.runCommand(
791:       binding,
792:       command.name,
793:       command.name === "compact" && command.args ? command.args : undefined,
794:     );
795:     return {
796:       sessionId: result.sessionId,
797:       notifySession: true,
798:       finalText: command.name === "compact" ? "当前会话上下文已压缩。" : "已重新加载扩展、Skills、Prompts 和工具。",
799:     };
800:   }

837:   private async handleInbound(envelope: InboundEnvelope): Promise<void> {
838:     await this.lanes.run(routeKey(envelope), async () => {
839:       const account = this.config.getAccount(envelope.accountId);
840:       if (!account || !account.enabled) return;
841:       const secret = await this.getSecret(account);
842:       if (!secret) throw new Error("Channel credential is unavailable");
843:       const decision = evaluateInboundPolicy(account, envelope);
844:       if (decision === "ignore") {
845:         this.addActivity({
846:           channel: account.channel,
847:           accountId: account.id,
848:           direction: "inbound",
849:           outcome: "ignored",
850:           peerId: envelope.peer.id,
851:           detail: "访问策略拒绝",
852:         });
853:         return;
854:       }
855:       if (decision === "pair") {
856:         await this.handlePairing(account, envelope, secret);
857:         this.addActivity({
858:           channel: account.channel,
859:           accountId: account.id,
860:           direction: "inbound",
861:           outcome: "ignored",
862:           peerId: envelope.peer.id,
863:           detail: "等待配对批准",
864:         });
865:         return;
866:       }
867:       if (!envelope.text.trim() && envelope.attachments.length === 0) {
868:         const label = "消息内容为空。";
869:         const receipt = await this.registry.get(account.channel).send({
870:           account,
871:           secret,
872:           peerId: envelope.peer.id,
873:           contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
874:           threadId: envelope.threadId,
875:           replyToMessageId: envelope.providerContext?.replyToMessageId,
876:           text: label,
877:         });
878:         this.state.addDelivery(receipt);
879:         return;
880:       }
881: 
882:       const binding = this.resolveBinding(account, envelope);
883:       const adapter = this.registry.get(account.channel);
884:       let stagedAttachments: StagedInboundAttachment[] = [];
885:       if (envelope.attachments.length > 0 && adapter.downloadInbound) {
886:         try {
887:           if (envelope.attachments.length > CHANNEL_MEDIA_MAX_ATTACHMENTS) {
888:             throw new Error(`单条消息最多支持 ${CHANNEL_MEDIA_MAX_ATTACHMENTS} 个附件`);
889:           }
890:           const downloaded = await adapter.downloadInbound({ account, secret, envelope });
891:           stagedAttachments = await this.media.stage(account.id, envelope.id, downloaded);
892:         } catch (error) {
893:           this.log(`[${account.id}] media download failed: ${safeChannelError(error)}`);
894:           const receipt = await adapter.send({
895:             account,
896:             secret,
897:             peerId: envelope.peer.id,
898:             contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
899:             threadId: envelope.threadId,
900:             replyToMessageId: envelope.providerContext?.replyToMessageId,
901:             text: "附件下载或校验失败。请确认文件不超过 20 MiB，并重新发送受支持的图片、文件或语音。",
902:           });
903:           this.state.addDelivery(receipt);
904:           this.addActivity({
905:             channel: account.channel,
906:             accountId: account.id,
907:             direction: "inbound",
908:             outcome: "ignored",
909:             peerId: envelope.peer.id,
910:             detail: "附件处理失败",
911:           });
912:           return;
913:         }
914:       }
915:       if (!envelope.text.trim() && stagedAttachments.length === 0) {
916:         const receipt = await adapter.send({
917:           account,
918:           secret,
919:           peerId: envelope.peer.id,
920:           contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
921:           threadId: envelope.threadId,
922:           replyToMessageId: envelope.providerContext?.replyToMessageId,
923:           text: "当前渠道或消息类型尚不支持该媒体附件。",
924:         });
925:         this.state.addDelivery(receipt);
926:         return;
927:       }
928:       this.addActivity({
929:         channel: account.channel,
930:         accountId: account.id,
931:         direction: "inbound",
932:         outcome: "accepted",
933:         peerId: envelope.peer.id,
934:       });
935:       await adapter
936:         .setTyping?.({
937:           account,
938:           secret,
939:           peerId: envelope.peer.id,
940:           contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
941:           threadId: envelope.threadId,
942:           typing: true,
943:         })
944:         .catch(() => undefined);
945:       let progressiveOutput: AdapterTurnOutput | undefined;
946:       try {
947:         const command = account.commandsEnabled === true ? parseChannelCommand(envelope.text) : null;
948:         progressiveOutput = command
949:           ? undefined
950:           : adapter.beginTurn?.({
951:               account,
952:               secret,
953:               peerId: envelope.peer.id,
954:               peerKind: envelope.peer.kind,
955:               contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
956:               threadId: envelope.threadId,
957:               replyToMessageId: envelope.providerContext?.replyToMessageId,
958:               runId: envelope.id,
959:             });
960:         const turn = command
961:           ? await this.handleCommand(account, binding, command)
962:           : {
963:               ...(await this.bridge.runTurn(
964:                 binding,
965:                 envelope,
966:                 (event) => progressiveOutput?.update(event),
967:                 stagedAttachments,
968:                 account.toolNames,
969:               )),
970:               notifySession: true,
971:             };
972:         if (turn.sessionId) this.saveBindingSession(binding, turn.sessionId);
973:         // Notify on every external turn, not only when a binding first gains a
974:         // session id. The active desktop chat uses this durable signal to
975:         // reload messages if the live agent stream was idle or interrupted.
976:         if (turn.notifySession && turn.sessionId) {
977:           const sessionCwd = "cwd" in turn && typeof turn.cwd === "string" ? turn.cwd : binding.cwd;
978:           const sessionPath = await resolveSessionPath(turn.sessionId).catch(() => null);
979:           const session = sessionPath ? await sessionIndex.refreshPath(sessionPath).catch(() => null) : null;
980:           if (session) {
981:             this.server.emit("sessions.changed", session.id, {
982:               cwd: session.cwd,
983:               sessionId: session.id,
984:               session,
985:             });
986:           } else {
987:             this.server.emit("sessions.changed", "*", {
988:               cwd: sessionCwd,
989:               sessionId: turn.sessionId,
990:               fullRefresh: true,
991:             });
992:           }
993:         }
994:         const text = turn.finalText || "Agent 已完成处理，但没有生成文本回复。";
995:         const receipt = progressiveOutput
996:           ? await progressiveOutput.finish(text)
997:           : await adapter.send({
998:               account,
999:               secret,
1000:               peerId: envelope.peer.id,
1001:               contextToken: envelope.providerContext?.contextToken,
1002:               threadId: envelope.threadId,
1003:               replyToMessageId: envelope.providerContext?.replyToMessageId,
1004:               text,
1005:               runId: envelope.id,
1006:             });

69:       context: AdapterTurnContext,
70:       markdown: string,
71:       fallbackText: string,
72:     ) => Promise<DeliveryReceipt>,
73:     private readonly setReaction: (context: AdapterTurnContext, emoji: string) => Promise<void>,
74:     private readonly timers: TurnTimers,
75:   ) {
76:     const chatId = Number(context.peerId);
77:     this.mode = context.peerKind === "dm" && Number.isSafeInteger(chatId) ? "rich" : "disabled";
78:     this.queueReaction("👀");
79:     this.schedule(0);
80:   }
81: 
82:   private queueReaction(emoji: string): void {
83:     if (!this.context.replyToMessageId) return;
84:     this.reactionTail = this.reactionTail.then(() => this.setReaction(this.context, emoji)).catch(() => undefined);
85:   }
86: 
87:   update(event: ChannelTurnProgressEvent): void {
88:     if (this.finished) return;
89:     this.builder.update(event);
90:     this.schedule(this.intervalMs);
91:   }
92: 
93:   private schedule(delayMs: number): void {
94:     if (this.finished || this.mode === "disabled" || this.timer) return;
95:     this.timer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => {
96:       this.timer = null;
97:       try {
98:         this.flush();
99:       } catch {
100:         // Draft rendering is optional. Malformed or partial Agent events must
101:         // never escape a timer callback and terminate the Agent Host.
102:         this.mode = "disabled";
103:       }
104:     }, delayMs);
105:   }
106: 
107:   private flush(): void {
108:     const richDraft = this.builder.renderDraft();
109:     const plainDraft = this.builder.renderPlainDraft();
110:     const next = this.mode === "rich" ? richDraft : plainDraft;
111:     if (!next || next === this.lastDraft) return;
112:     this.lastDraft = next;
113:     const draftId = telegramDraftId(this.context.runId ?? `${this.context.account.id}:${this.context.peerId}`);
114:     this.tail = this.tail.then(async () => {
115:       if (this.finished || this.mode === "disabled") return;
116:       if (this.mode === "rich") {
117:         try {
118:           await this.sendRichDraft(this.context, draftId, richDraft);
119:           return;
120:         } catch {
121:           this.mode = "plain";
122:           this.lastDraft = plainDraft;
123:         }
124:       }
125:       if (this.finished) return;
126:       try {
127:         await this.sendPlainDraft(this.context, draftId, plainDraft);
128:       } catch {
129:         this.mode = "disabled";
130:       }
131:     });
132:   }
133: 
134:   async finish(text: string): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
135:     this.finished = true;
136:     if (this.timer) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.timer);
137:     this.timer = null;
138:     await this.tail;
139:     let markdown = "";
140:     try {
141:       markdown = this.builder.renderFinal(text);
142:     } catch {
143:       // Preserve the final reply through the established plain-text fallback.
144:     }
145:     try {
146:       const result = await this.sendFinal(this.context, markdown, text);
147:       this.queueReaction("👍");
148:       return result;
149:     } catch (error) {
150:       this.queueReaction("👎");
151:       throw error;
152:     }
153:   }
154: 
155:   async cancel(): Promise<void> {
156:     this.finished = true;
157:     if (this.timer) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.timer);
158:     this.timer = null;
159:     await this.tail;
160:     this.queueReaction("👎");
161:   }
162: }

164: function delay(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
165:   if (signal.aborted) return Promise.resolve();
166:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
167:     const finish = () => {
168:       clearTimeout(timer);
169:       signal.removeEventListener("abort", finish);
170:       resolve();
171:     };
172:     const timer = setTimeout(finish, ms);
173:     signal.addEventListener("abort", finish, { once: true });
174:   });
175: }

177: function isFatalTelegramError(error: unknown): boolean {
178:   return error instanceof TelegramApiError && [401, 403, 409].includes(error.errorCode);
179: }
180: 
181: function telegramErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
182:   if (error instanceof TelegramApiError && error.errorCode === 409) {
183:     return "Telegram polling 冲突：请关闭其他使用该 Bot Token 的 poller，并确认 Bot 未配置 webhook";
184:   }
185:   if (error instanceof TelegramApiError && (error.errorCode === 401 || error.errorCode === 403)) {
186:     return "Telegram Bot Token 无效或机器人访问已被撤销，请更新 Token";
187:   }
188:   if (error instanceof TelegramApiError && error.errorCode === 429) {
189:     return `Telegram 请求受限，将在 ${error.retryAfter ?? 1} 秒后重试`;
190:   }
191:   if (error instanceof TelegramApiError && error.errorCode >= 500) {
192:     return "Telegram 服务暂时不可用，稍后将自动重试";
193:   }
194:   if (error instanceof TypeError || (error instanceof Error && /fetch failed|network/i.test(error.message))) {
195:     return "Telegram 网络请求失败，稍后将自动重试";
196:   }
197:   return safeChannelError(error);
198: }

200: function canFallbackFromRichMessage(error: unknown): boolean {
201:   return error instanceof TelegramApiError && [400, 404].includes(error.errorCode);
202: }

204: function entityText(text: string, entity: TelegramMessageEntity): string {
205:   return text.slice(entity.offset, entity.offset + entity.length);
206: }
207: 
208: function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
209:   return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
210: }
211: 
212: function mentionsTelegramBot(
213:   text: string,
214:   entities: TelegramMessageEntity[],
215:   botId: string,
216:   botUsername?: string,
217: ): boolean {
218:   const username = botUsername?.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();
219:   if (
220:     entities.some((entity) => {
221:       if (entity.type === "text_mention") return String(entity.user?.id ?? "") === botId;
222:       if (!username || (entity.type !== "mention" && entity.type !== "bot_command")) return false;
223:       return entityText(text, entity).toLowerCase().endsWith(`@${username}`);
224:     })
225:   ) {
226:     return true;
227:   }
228:   return username ? new RegExp(`@${escapeRegExp(username)}(?![a-z0-9_])`, "i").test(text) : false;
229: }
230: 
231: function removeTelegramBotMention(text: string, botUsername?: string): string {
232:   const username = botUsername?.replace(/^@/, "");
233:   if (!username) return text.trim();
234:   return text.replace(new RegExp(`@${escapeRegExp(username)}(?![a-z0-9_])`, "gi"), "").trim();
235: }

237: function attachmentMetadata(update: TelegramUpdate): InboundAttachment[] {
238:   const message = update.message;
239:   if (!message) return [];
240:   const attachments: InboundAttachment[] = [];
241:   if (message.photo?.length) attachments.push({ kind: "image", mime: "image/jpeg" });
242:   if (message.voice)
243:     attachments.push({ kind: "voice", ...(message.voice.mime_type ? { mime: message.voice.mime_type } : {}) });
244:   if (message.document) {
245:     attachments.push({
246:       kind: "file",
247:       ...(message.document.file_name ? { name: message.document.file_name } : {}),
248:       ...(message.document.mime_type ? { mime: message.document.mime_type } : {}),
249:     });
250:   }
251:   if (message.audio) {
252:     attachments.push({
253:       kind: "file",
254:       ...(message.audio.file_name ? { name: message.audio.file_name } : {}),
255:       ...(message.audio.mime_type ? { mime: message.audio.mime_type } : {}),
256:     });
257:   }
258:   if (message.video || message.animation || message.video_note) {
259:     const media = message.video ?? message.animation ?? message.video_note;
260:     attachments.push({ kind: "video", ...(media?.mime_type ? { mime: media.mime_type } : {}) });
261:   }
262:   return attachments;
263: }
264: 
265: function downloadableAttachments(update: TelegramUpdate): Array<{
266:   kind: "image" | "voice" | "file";
267:   file: TelegramFileAttachment;
268:   name?: string;
269:   mime?: string;
270: }> {
271:   const message = update.message;
272:   if (!message) return [];
273:   const result: Array<{
274:     kind: "image" | "voice" | "file";
275:     file: TelegramFileAttachment;
276:     name?: string;
277:     mime?: string;
278:   }> = [];
279:   const photo = message.photo?.filter((item) => item.file_id).at(-1);
280:   if (photo) result.push({ kind: "image", file: photo, mime: "image/jpeg" });
281:   if (message.voice?.file_id) {
282:     result.push({
283:       kind: "voice",
284:       file: message.voice,
285:       name: "voice.ogg",
286:       mime: message.voice.mime_type || "audio/ogg",
287:     });
288:   }
289:   for (const file of [message.document, message.audio]) {
290:     if (!file?.file_id) continue;
291:     result.push({
292:       kind: "file",
293:       file,
294:       ...(file.file_name ? { name: file.file_name } : {}),
295:       ...(file.mime_type ? { mime: file.mime_type } : {}),
296:     });
297:   }
298:   return result;
299: }

301: export function normalizeTelegramUpdate(
302:   update: TelegramUpdate,
303:   account: ChannelAccountConfig,
304:   bot: Pick<TelegramUser, "id" | "username">,
305: ): InboundEnvelope | null {
306:   const message = update.message;
307:   const sender = message?.from;
308:   if (!message || !sender || sender.is_bot || message.chat.type === "channel") return null;
309:   const peerKind = message.chat.type === "private" ? "dm" : "group";
310:   const originalText = message.text ?? message.caption ?? "";
311:   const entities = message.text ? (message.entities ?? []) : (message.caption_entities ?? []);
312:   const mentionsBot = mentionsTelegramBot(originalText, entities, String(bot.id), bot.username);
313:   const senderName = [sender.first_name, sender.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
314:   const repliedMessage = message.reply_to_message;
315:   const repliedText = repliedMessage?.text ?? repliedMessage?.caption;
316:   const repliedSenderId = repliedMessage?.from?.id ?? repliedMessage?.sender_chat?.id;
317:   return {
318:     id: String(update.update_id),
319:     channel: "telegram",
320:     accountId: account.id,
321:     peer: { kind: peerKind, id: String(message.chat.id) },
322:     ...(message.message_thread_id !== undefined ? { threadId: String(message.message_thread_id) } : {}),
323:     sender: {
324:       id: String(sender.id),
325:       ...(senderName ? { name: senderName } : {}),
326:       ...(sender.username ? { username: sender.username } : {}),
327:     },
328:     text: peerKind === "group" ? removeTelegramBotMention(originalText, bot.username) : originalText,
329:     mentionsBot,
330:     ...(repliedMessage
331:       ? {
332:           replyTo: {
333:             messageId: String(repliedMessage.message_id),
334:             ...(repliedText ? { text: repliedText } : {}),
335:             ...(repliedSenderId !== undefined ? { senderId: String(repliedSenderId) } : {}),
336:           },
337:         }
338:       : {}),
339:     attachments: attachmentMetadata(update),
340:     timestamp: message.date * 1_000,
341:     providerContext: { replyToMessageId: String(message.message_id) },
342:   };
343: }

345: export class TelegramAdapter implements ChannelAdapter {
346:   readonly id = "telegram" as const;
347:   private readonly pendingMedia = new Map<string, TelegramUpdate>();
348: 
349:   constructor(
350:     private readonly sleep: (ms: number, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void> = delay,
351:     private readonly draftIntervalMs = DEFAULT_DRAFT_INTERVAL_MS,
352:     private readonly turnTimers: TurnTimers = globalThis,
353:   ) {}
354: 
355:   async start(context: AdapterStartContext): Promise<void> {
356:     const { account, secret, signal, state, onInbound, onStatus } = context;
357:     let offset = Number.parseInt(state.getCursor(account.id), 10);
358:     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0) offset = 0;
359:     let failures = 0;
360:     onStatus({ state: "starting", connected: false, lastStartAt: Date.now(), retryCount: 0 });
361: 
362:     try {
363:       let bot: TelegramUser | undefined;
364:       while (!signal.aborted && !bot) {
365:         try {
366:           bot = await getTelegramBot({ baseUrl: secret.baseUrl, token: secret.token, signal });
367:         } catch (error) {
368:           if (signal.aborted) break;
369:           if (isFatalTelegramError(error)) throw new Error(telegramErrorMessage(error));
370:           failures += 1;
371:           const retryAfter = error instanceof TelegramApiError ? error.retryAfter : undefined;
372:           const backoff = retryAfter
373:             ? Math.min(Math.max(retryAfter, 1) * 1_000, MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS)
374:             : Math.min(2_000 * 2 ** Math.min(failures - 1, 4), MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
375:           onStatus({
376:             state: "reconnecting",
377:             connected: false,
378:             retryCount: failures,
379:             lastError: telegramErrorMessage(error),
380:           });
381:           await this.sleep(backoff, signal);
382:         }
383:       }
384:       if (!bot) return;
385:       if (account.providerAccountId && account.providerAccountId !== String(bot.id)) {
386:         throw new Error("Telegram Bot Token 与已保存的机器人账号不匹配");
387:       }
388:       try {
389:         if (account.commandsEnabled === true) {
390:           await setTelegramCommands({
391:             baseUrl: secret.baseUrl,
392:             token: secret.token,
393:             commands: CHANNEL_COMMAND_MENU.map((item) => ({ ...item })),
394:             signal,
395:           });
396:         } else if (account.commandsEnabled === false) {
397:           await deleteTelegramCommands({ baseUrl: secret.baseUrl, token: secret.token, signal });
398:         }
399:       } catch (error) {
400:         if (!signal.aborted) context.log(`Telegram 命令菜单同步失败：${telegramErrorMessage(error)}`);
401:       }
402:       failures = 0;
403:       onStatus({ state: "running", connected: true, lastConnectedAt: Date.now(), lastError: undefined });
404: 
405:       while (!signal.aborted) {
406:         try {
407:           const updates = await getTelegramUpdates({
408:             baseUrl: secret.baseUrl,
409:             token: secret.token,
410:             ...(offset > 0 ? { offset } : {}),
411:             timeoutSeconds: POLL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
412:             signal,
413:           });
414:           if (signal.aborted) break;
415: 
416:           for (const update of updates) {
417:             const eventId = String(update.update_id);
418:             if (!state.isProcessed(account.id, eventId)) {
419:               const envelope = normalizeTelegramUpdate(update, account, bot);
420:               if (envelope) {
421:                 onStatus({ lastInboundAt: Date.now(), lastEventAt: Date.now() });
422:                 this.pendingMedia.set(envelope.id, update);
423:                 try {
424:                   await onInbound(envelope);
425:                 } catch (error) {
426:                   context.log(
427:                     `Telegram 入站消息处理失败（event ${eventId.slice(0, 128)}）：${safeChannelError(error)}`,
428:                   );
429:                 } finally {
430:                   this.pendingMedia.delete(envelope.id);
431:                 }
432:               }
433:               state.markProcessed(account.id, eventId);
434:             }
435:           }
436: 
437:           if (updates.length > 0) {
438:             const nextOffset = Math.max(...updates.map((update) => update.update_id)) + 1;
439:             if (nextOffset > offset) {
440:               offset = nextOffset;
441:               state.setCursor(account.id, String(offset));
442:             }
443:           }
444:           failures = 0;
445:           onStatus({ state: "running", connected: true, lastEventAt: Date.now(), retryCount: 0, lastError: undefined });
446:         } catch (error) {
447:           if (signal.aborted) break;
448:           if (isFatalTelegramError(error)) throw new Error(telegramErrorMessage(error));
449:           failures += 1;
450:           const retryAfter = error instanceof TelegramApiError ? error.retryAfter : undefined;
451:           const backoff = retryAfter
452:             ? Math.min(Math.max(retryAfter, 1) * 1_000, MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS)
453:             : Math.min(2_000 * 2 ** Math.min(failures - 1, 4), MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
454:           onStatus({
455:             state: "reconnecting",
456:             connected: false,
457:             retryCount: failures,
458:             lastError: telegramErrorMessage(error),
459:           });
460:           await this.sleep(backoff, signal);
461:         }
462:       }
463:     } finally {
464:       onStatus({ state: "stopped", connected: false });
465:     }
466:   }

468:   private async retryRateLimit<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
469:     let attempts = 0;
470:     while (true) {
471:       try {
472:         return await operation();
473:       } catch (error) {
474:         if (!(error instanceof TelegramApiError) || error.errorCode !== 429 || attempts >= 2) throw error;
475:         attempts += 1;
476:         await this.sleep(
477:           Math.min(Math.max(error.retryAfter ?? 1, 1) * 1_000, MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS),
478:           new AbortController().signal,
479:         );
480:       }
481:     }
482:   }

513:   private async sendPlain(context: AdapterSendContext): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
514:     const chunks = splitChannelText(context.text, 4_000);
515:     if (chunks.length === 0) throw new Error("Cannot send an empty Telegram message");
516:     let messageId = "";
517:     for (let index = 0; index < chunks.length; index += 1) {
518:       const message = await this.retryRateLimit(() =>
519:         sendTelegramMessage({
520:           baseUrl: context.secret.baseUrl,
521:           token: context.secret.token,
522:           chatId: context.peerId,
523:           html: escapeTelegramHtml(chunks[index]),
524:           threadId: context.threadId,
525:           ...(index === 0 && context.replyToMessageId ? { replyToMessageId: context.replyToMessageId } : {}),
526:         }),
527:       );
528:       messageId = String(message.message_id);
529:     }
530:     return this.receipt(context, messageId);
531:   }

533:   private async sendRichOrFallback(
534:     context: AdapterSendContext,
535:     markdown: string,
536:     fallbackText: string,
537:   ): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
538:     if (!markdown.trim() || [...markdown].length > TELEGRAM_RICH_SAFE_LIMIT) {
539:       return this.sendPlain({ ...context, text: fallbackText });
540:     }
541:     try {
542:       const message = await this.retryRateLimit(() =>
543:         sendTelegramRichMessage({
544:           baseUrl: context.secret.baseUrl,
545:           token: context.secret.token,
546:           chatId: context.peerId,
547:           markdown,
548:           threadId: context.threadId,
549:           replyToMessageId: context.replyToMessageId,
550:         }),
551:       );
552:       return this.receipt(context, String(message.message_id));
553:     } catch (error) {
554:       if (!canFallbackFromRichMessage(error)) throw error;
555:       return this.sendPlain({ ...context, text: fallbackText });

559:   async send(context: AdapterSendContext): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
560:     if (context.attachments?.length) {
561:       let receipt: DeliveryReceipt | undefined;
562:       if (context.text.trim())
563:         receipt = await this.sendRichOrFallback(
564:           context,
565:           new TelegramRichMessageBuilder().renderFinal(context.text),
566:           context.text,
567:         );
568:       for (let index = 0; index < context.attachments.length; index += 1) {
569:         const attachment = context.attachments[index];
570:         const message = await this.retryRateLimit(() =>
571:           sendTelegramMedia({
572:             baseUrl: context.secret.baseUrl,
573:             token: context.secret.token,
574:             chatId: context.peerId,
575:             kind: attachment.kind,
576:             path: attachment.path,
577:             name: attachment.name,
578:             mime: attachment.mime,
579:             threadId: context.threadId,
580:             ...(!receipt && index === 0 && context.replyToMessageId
581:               ? { replyToMessageId: context.replyToMessageId }
582:               : {}),
583:           }),
584:         );
585:         receipt = this.receipt(context, String(message.message_id));
586:       }
587:       if (receipt) return receipt;
588:     }
589:     const builder = new TelegramRichMessageBuilder();
590:     return this.sendRichOrFallback(context, builder.renderFinal(context.text), context.text);

514: ): Promise<FeishuWsConnection> {

516:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

518:     let closed = false;
519:     let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

521:     const cleanupTimer = () => {
522:       if (timer) timers.clearTimeout(timer);
523:       timer = undefined;
524:     };
525:     const close = () => {
526:       if (closed) return;
527:       closed = true;
528:       cleanupTimer();
529:       signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
530:       client.close({ force: true });
531:     };
532:     const failInitial = (error: Error) => {
533:       if (settled) return;
534:       settled = true;
535:       cleanupTimer();
536:       close();
537:       reject(error);
538:     };

544:     const client = new Lark.WSClient({
545:       appId: credentials.appId,
546:       appSecret: credentials.appSecret,
547:       domain: sdkDomain(credentials.domain),
548:       loggerLevel: Lark.LoggerLevel.error,
549:       logger: silentLogger,

551:       autoReconnect: true,
552:       handshakeTimeoutMs: 15_000,
553:       wsConfig: { pingTimeout: 10 },
554:       onReady: () => {

556:         settled = true;
557:         cleanupTimer();
558:         resolve({ close });
559:       },
560:       onError: (error) => {
561:         const normalized = normalizeThrownError(error, "飞书/Lark 长连接", credentials.appSecret);
562:         hooks.onError(normalized);
563:         failInitial(normalized);

566:       onReconnected: hooks.onReconnected,
567:     });
